utfall: Sysselsetting 3.5 år etter start, alle aldre (unge 16-29 var prioritert, men utvalget er eldre; ingen egne resultater for under 30); tilskudd dekker lønnskostnad i seks måneder
sammenligning: tilbud om jobbintervju for subsidiert stilling mot ikke tilbud (loddtrekning, ITT)
sitat: Using administrative employment data, we find that attending the job interview led to an increase of 15 percentage points in the likelihood of being employed 3.5 years after the start of the intervention.

utfall: Sysselsetting etter ett år for 45 år og yngre (stor startfordel, kontrollgruppen tar igjen); ingen egen gruppe under 30
sammenligning: tilbud om jobbintervju mot ikke tilbud, 45 år og yngre
sitat: For younger job seekers, the program has a large initial effect on employment but the control group catches up relatively quickly and, after one year, the employment gap reduces to 8 percentage points.

utfall: Sysselsetting for dem som fikk tilbud om subsidiert jobb (IV/TOT), alle aldre
sammenligning: tilbud om subsidiert jobb mot kontrollgruppe (loddtrekning som instrument)
sitat: Using the random assignment to the interview as an instrument for being offered a SEP job, we estimate even larger employment impacts, of about 50 percentage points over the counterfactual employment rates of the control group, for those job seekers who were offered the subsidized employment.
